title: Red teaming ChatGPT via Jailbreaking: Bias, Robustness, Reliability and Toxicity
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable; the paper cites religious bias as a known issue in LLMs but does not measure it in its own experiments.
findings: The paper cites prior research on religious bias (specifically anti-Muslim bias) in LLMs but does not conduct any direct experiments or present new findings related to religion or faith. Its own bias evaluation focuses on gender and race.
